basic_info.description: You can have it all in the heart of the city!  This recently remodeled 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom condo at The Sutterfield features an expansive floor plan and views of downtown San Francisco.  Floor-to-ceiling windows provide great light throughout the day.  The views of downtown San Francisco and peek-a-boo views of the bay are amazing during the day and at night.  Complete with in-unit laundry and 1 car deeded parking, this unit has everything you could ask for. The recently updated kitchen includes new cabinets, appliances, white quartz Caesarstone counters, and a stainless steel sink.  The bathrooms include updated fixtures, and the hardwood floors have been recently refinished with updated carpet in the bedroom.  Crown molding, new blinds, and fresh paint complete the upgrades in this sleek home. The Sutterfield is a full service building with an elegant lobby and 24-hour doorman.  The fitness center includes a sauna and an outdoor spa.  The convenient location near Japantown, City Hall, Lower Polk, the Fillmore District, and Tech Shuttle stops gives The Sutterfield a 97% walkscore and 100% transit score.
